title: RingForge FE Beta
features:
Perfect Circles: Uses math to build completely seamless, flawless rings with zero gaps.
Auto-Sizing: Instantly calculates the exact width and depth needed for every block.
Live Hologram: Shows a clear preview ring so you can see your build before placing it.
Smart Selector: Hover over any block to lock in your center anchor point easily.
RGB Sliders: Drag custom red, green, and blue sliders to pick any color on the fly. Hex Codes: Type in standard hex strings (like #FF0000) to match colors instantly.
Serverwide (FE): Fully bypasses FilteringEnabled so every player sees your builds.
Lag-Proof: Uses safe delays between blocks to prevent network lag or disconnections.
Draggable UI: Move the dark-themed menu anywhere on your screen out of the way.
Pop-out Panels: Open or hide the advanced color picker and user guide instantly.
Selectable Link: Easily copy the community support link text on any device.
